descriptorOverlays.activeClassification: A candidate window is active only when the independently authored stress reference PCM RMS is finite and strictly greater than 0.0. A finite zero-RMS reference window is inactive for this relative-ratio check and remains governed by the other V3 semantics. Output bytes never classify activity or establish the denominator.
descriptorOverlays.regions: Apply to the V3 full quality region and every V3 track-onset quality region, using every contiguous complete 960-sample window.
descriptorOverlays.retainedV3Checks: All V3 structure, timing, signed correlation, NRMSE, SNR, aggregate RMS ratio, DC, tone, clipping, and onset checks remain required.
evidence: minimum and maximum output/reference RMS ratio
explicit expected and observed onset samples and seconds, with signed error in both units
descriptorOverlays.failClosed: A non-finite reference RMS fails; a non-finite output RMS or ratio for an active window fails; no eligible active windows fails.

requiredSyntheticControls: exact stress truth identity passes reference-relative windows
stress truth gain 0.95 passes reference-relative windows
localized low-level 960-sample dropout fails through reference-relative-window-rms-ratio
all 12 exact V3 legacy controls retain their frozen dispositions and hashes
all V4 structured controls retain their frozen dispositions and hashes
nonClaims: a change to the V3 frozen contract or its historical control evidence
a change to the V4 amendment or its historical control evidence
a change to any descriptor other than stress-4v8a-30s
route admission or rejection before the required synthetic controls pass
